title: The ace of spades
html_source: Who or what is the “ace of spades”? Haines dreamed of a black panther and now we have a dream of the ace of spades. Well, Bloom is dressed in black “for the funeral.” Is it Bloom the object of the dreams?

anchor.prefix:
hat? Mr Bloom asked. 

 Let her speak. Look straight in her eyes. I believe you. Trust me. 

 — Woke me up in the night, she said. Dream he had, a nightmare. 

 Indiges. 

 — Said
anchor.suffix:
was walking up the stairs. 

 — The ace of spades! Mr Bloom said. 

 She took a folded postcard from her handbag. 

 — Read that, she said. He got it this morning.
